forbidden_automatic_promotions.reason: Formal proof does not establish implementation conformance.
Formal proof does not execute an empirical experiment.
Software conformance is not empirical validation.
Replay is computational assurance, not a new measurement.
Replay does not establish physical truth.
A model saying, predicting, or describing that work was executed is not evidence that execution occurred.

nodes.meaning: Encoding of a statement in a formal language
Proof accepted by the declared formal environment
Audit of theorem surface, proof holes, axioms and toolchain identity
Declared implementation intended to realize selected semantics
Explicit mapping between formal objects and runtime surfaces
Observed test result under a declared conformance contract
Replay result under frozen deterministic execution identity
Generated model content, treated as untrusted input unless separately evidenced
Independent retained evidence that a declared execution actually occurred
Scientific hypothesis with declared empirical target
Scientific interpretation supported by separately identified evidence

rule: Only an explicitly named support edge establishes the declared relation. No transitive promotion across edge types is inferred. A pair cannot be both supported and forbidden.
